title: Regional hot-cache priming and fallback strategy gating
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Implement an orchestrator that proactively validates and gates regional failover paths by verifying hot KV-cache integrity, candidate model-variant compatibility, and tier-aware routing thresholds before switching traffic. This reduces customer-visible latency spikes and model-quality regressions during cross-region cutovers.

Scope:
- Design a gated readiness check that combines (1) KV cache freshness checks, (2) model-variant signature compatibility tests, (3) per-tier latency/cost SLO validation, and (4) incremental canary siphoning to measure end-to-end behaviour.
- Add a routing policy extension to Console to express gating thresholds and fallback variant maps.
- Implement lightweight preflight probes and a scoring function used by the failover controller to decide automatic cutover vs. manual intervention.

Out of scope:
- Long-term cross-region replication of full KV state (we rely on targeted prefix seeding).
- Changes to underlying hardware placement algorithms.
acceptance_criteria: Readiness score computed for any candidate region and variant pair (0-100) and persisted to routing dashboard
Controller will block automated cutover if readiness score < 70 and surface a remediation checklist
Canary siphon executes with configurable traffic fraction and automatically ramps only if no regression in token-latency or quality alerts within 5 minutes
Console UI exposes routing gate configuration and indicates last readiness probe time per-region
Automated preflight probes validate KV prefix hits for a representative prompt set and return failure reasons for any mismatched embeddings or missing shard ranges
technical_notes: Readiness score components: kv_hit_rate (40%), signature_compat (30%), p50_latency_ratio_vs_baseline (20%), model_quality_delta (10%)
KV probe: sample 200 recent prefixes (weighted by traffic heatmap) and run async liveness + content-hash verification
Model-variant signature test: run a deterministic prompt set (50 prompts) using the model variant and check tokenization/response schema differences; flag mismatches > 2%
Tier-aware gating: mapping table for Gold/Silver/Bronze routes that sets stricter thresholds for Gold (score>=80) vs Bronze (score>=60)
Fallback maps: allow policy to list ordered compatible variants; controller walks list and computes readiness until it finds first acceptable candidate
Telemetry: emit readiness_score.{region}.{variant} and readiness_probe.failure_reasons to tracing and metrics (prometheus + honeycomb)
Safety: fail-open only for emergency 'global outage' mode set by oncall; default is fail-closed to prevent silent quality regressions

progress_updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting — agreed on composite readiness score and initial weights. Product accepted baseline gating thresholds.
2025-02-18: KV probe prototype returns stable hit-rate numbers on staging dataset; discovered non-uniform shard distribution causing false negatives — Miguel implemented weighted sampling fix.
2025-02-25: Model-variant runner found a tokenizer mismatch on quantized v2 variant for two prompts; flagged as a regression and added additional signature checks.
2025-03-01: Console mockups reviewed by PM/Design. Design requested clearer failure reasons in UI and an 'explainability' panel for operators.

2025-03-04: Canary siphon prototype implemented behind feature flag; initial experiments show transient p95 increase for one variant — holding decision to block automated cutover until model team investigates.
qa_plan: Create synthetic region-failure scenarios in staging using fault-injector
Validate readiness_score delta when seeding different KV prefix completeness levels
Run canary siphon flows at 1% and 5% traffic and assert rollback triggers on quality or latency regressions
Manual verification checklist for oncall to approve blocked cutover
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Backend readiness probes + metrics only (no gating) deployed to staging (1 week)
Phase 2: Enable scoring + soft-gate (controller logs decision but does not block) for internal canaries (2 weeks)
Phase 3: Enable hard-gate for non-critical Bronze routes, monitor 48h, iterate thresholds (2 weeks)
Phase 4: Enable hard-gate for Gold routes and onboard customers (1 week)
